description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named GlowingOpenClawIcon that displays an animated, glowing icon with customizable size and glow intensity. It manages scene phase changes to animate a breathing effect on the icon.

classes.name: GlowingOpenClawIcon
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a glowing, animated icon with optional floating effect.

methods.name: updateBreatheAnimation
methods.description: Updates the breathing animation state based on scene activity and floating enablement.
